package m

import (
	"fmt"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// invoke drives every method of the mock m (a pointer to a generated mock) through reflection:
// a call without its Func must panic with the documented message and record nothing, and a call
// with a zero-value Func must be recorded exactly once.
func invoke(t *testing.T, m any) {
	t.Helper()

	v := reflect.ValueOf(m)
	st := v.Elem()
	tn := st.Type().Name()

	if i := strings.IndexByte(tn, '['); i >= 0 {
		tn = tn[:i]
	}

	n := 0

	for i := 0; i < st.NumField(); i++ {
		f := st.Type().Field(i)
		if !f.IsExported() || f.Type.Kind() != reflect.Func || !strings.HasSuffix(f.Name, "Func") {
			continue
		}

		n++

		name := strings.TrimSuffix(f.Name, "Func")
		mv := v.MethodByName(name)
		args := make([]reflect.Value, mv.Type().NumIn())

		if mv.Type().IsVariadic() {
			args = args[:len(args)-1]
		}

		for j := range args {
			args[j] = reflect.Zero(mv.Type().In(j))
		}

		want := fmt.Sprintf("mimic: %s.%s called, but %s is nil", tn, name, f.Name)
		if got := callRecover(mv, args); got != want {
			t.Errorf("nil Func panic = %q, want %q", got, want)
		}

		ft := f.Type
		st.Field(i).Set(reflect.MakeFunc(ft, func([]reflect.Value) []reflect.Value {
			res := make([]reflect.Value, ft.NumOut())
			for k := range res {
				res[k] = reflect.Zero(ft.Out(k))
			}

			return res
		}))

		if got := callRecover(mv, args); got != "" {
			t.Errorf("%s: unexpected panic %q", name, got)
		}

		if got := v.MethodByName(name + "Calls").Call(nil)[0].Len(); got != 1 {
			t.Errorf("%sCalls() has %d entries, want 1", name, got)
		}
	}

	if n == 0 {
		t.Error("mock has no Func field")
	}
}

func callRecover(mv reflect.Value, args []reflect.Value) (msg string) {
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			msg = fmt.Sprint(r)
		}
	}()

	mv.Call(args)

	return ""
}
